changelog: Timers, repeating events that actually repeat, and a day planner. Set a timer by asking - "set a pasta timer for 12 minutes" - and watch it count down in the header; timers survive closing the app, so one that finished while DensAssistant was shut tells you when you reopen it instead of quietly disappearing. Repeating events now work properly: "remind me every weekday at 9" repeats on your PC as well as your phone, and richer schedules work too - every other Tuesday, the third Friday of the month, the last day of the month. A monthly reminder starting on the 31st stays on the 31st and skips the months that don't have one, instead of drifting a few days later every month. New: a Plan tab that blocks out your day from your calendar and your open to-dos - most urgent work first, meetings left alone, lunch protected, and anything you place or pin is yours because replanning works around it and never overwrites it. Also fixed: a repeating event created on your phone now arrives on your PC still repeating, where it used to become a one-off.
